comments.body: @benvanik does this look to you like a IREE issue or a bug in my local vulkan driver (which accounts for at least one of the stack frames here) ?
I'm going to guess driver - they often don't play well with TSAN as they aren't instrumented.

Actually I wonder if there might be something actionable for us here!

The story told by this TSan report is, IIUC, as follows.

First, we did `iree_hal_vulkan_driver_create_device`, which caused the Vulkan driver to create a thread `T34`, which is currently waiting in `pthread_barrier_wait`.

Then, in our main thread, we are doing `iree_hal_vulkan_device_destroy`, which is calling into the Vulkan driver, which does a `pthread_barrier_destroy` on that same barrier.

So maybe it is the Vulkan driver's fault for doing a `pthread_barrier_destroy` under the feet of its own other thread that was doing `pthread_barrier_wait`.

Or is it a symptom of `iree_hal_vulkan_device_destroy` forgetting to do something that would let the Vulkan driver thread `T34` to stop waiting before that point?

OK it really is a driver bug, I think now.  I verified that the main thread `pthread_barrier_destroy` that is made by the vulkan driver, is done under this `vkQueueWaitIdle` call here:

https://sourcegraph.com/github.com/google/iree@1c84fdfdf12db994f201ea349c40fd789642420a/-/blob/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/vulkan/command_queue.h?L28:13

Not knowing anything about Vulkan, I'm going with the theory that if the Vulkan driver thinks that `vkQueueWaitIdle` should perform a `pthread_barrier_destroy`, then it should at least ensure that that isn't racing with a `pthread_barrier_wait` on one of its own internal threads (`T34` here).

```
Thread 1 "vulkan_allocato" hit Breakpoint 1, 0x00000000002e3640 in pthread_barrier_destroy ()
(gdb) bt 4
#0  0x00000000002e3640 in pthread_barrier_destroy ()
#1  0x00007ffff50772e3 in ?? () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libvulkan_lvp.so
#2  0x00007ffff50383da in ?? () from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libvulkan_lvp.so
#3  0x00000000004034ed in iree::hal::vulkan::CommandQueue::~CommandQueue (this=0x7b1400023c30) at /usr/local/google/home/benoitjacob/iree/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/vulkan/command_queue.h:29
(More stack frames follow...)
(gdb) frame 3
#3  0x00000000004034ed in iree::hal::vulkan::CommandQueue::~CommandQueue (this=0x7b1400023c30) at /usr/local/google/home/benoitjacob/iree/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/vulkan/command_queue.h:29
29	    syms()->vkQueueWaitIdle(queue_);
```
Closing as just a driver bug.
